children: MILAN, Oct. 28, 2026

-- Bending Spoons S.p.A. (“Bending Spoons”) today announced the pricing of an upsized dual-currency senior secured notes offering (the “Offerings”) with an aggregate principal amount equivalent to approximately $1.8 billion. The Offerings comprise $1.25 billion aggregate principal amount of 9.625% U.S. dollar-denominated senior secured notes and €500 million aggregate principal amount of 8.625% euro-denominated senior secured notes (collectively, the “Notes”), both due in 2032. Both tranches will be issued at 100% of their principal amount. The Offerings were upsized from the originally proposed $1.5 billion (approximate equivalent) following considerable demand.

The U.S. dollar-denominated Notes will be issued by Bending Spoons US Inc., a Delaware corporation, while the euro-denominated Notes will be issued by Bending Spoons Operations S.p.A., a joint stock company
(società per azioni)
organized under the laws of Italy. Each issuer is an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of Bending Spoons. Bending Spoons will not issue or guarantee the notes.
The net proceeds from the Offerings are intended to fund future acquisitions, to pay costs, fees, expenses, and taxes in connection with the Offerings, and for other general corporate purposes.

Application will be made for the Notes to be listed on the Official List of the Luxembourg Stock Exchange and admitted to trading on the Specialist Securities Segment of its Euro MTF Market. Settlement of the Offering is expected to occur on or about November 4, 2026, and is subject to customary closing conditions.

This press release is being issued pursuant to Rule 135c under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the “Securities Act”). It does not constitute an offer to sell or the solicitation of an offer to buy the Notes or any other securities.

The Notes are being offered only to persons reasonably believed to be qualified institutional buyers in reliance on Rule 144A under the Securities Act, and to non-U.S. persons outside the United States in reliance on Regulation S under the Securities Act. The Notes and the related guarantees have not been and will not be registered under the Securities Act or the securities laws of any other jurisdiction and may not be offered or sold in the United States absent registration or an applicable exemption from the registration requirements of the Securities Act and applicable state securities laws.
